gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests for {@link Tag} covering case-insensitive tag resolution and the {@code FormSubmittable} option exposed via {@link Tag#isFormSubmittable()}.
ADDED i2: Resolving a tag by name is case-insensitive, regardless of the JVM's default locale. "script" and "SCRIPT" must resolve to equal tags, and within a single {@lin
ADDED i3: Tag.valueOf caches per the shared HTML TagSet, so differing case yields equal tags.
ADDED i4: Resolving against the same TagSet returns the identical instance for either case.
ADDED i5: The {@code FormSubmittable} option is reported only for tags that participate in form submission: {@code } is form-submittable while {@code } is not
ADDED i6: Capture the option flags before querying, to confirm the query is side-effect free.
ADDED i7: isFormSubmittable() is a pure read; the option flags are unchanged.
